links.outcome: Goals of care documentation before vs after workflow tied to risk-category outputs
links.effect: Documentation rose for high-risk patients (17.6%-70.8%, P<0.0001) and intermediate-risk patients (9.6%-28.0%, P<0.0001) after implementation.
links.quote: Postimplementation, goals of care documentation increased for high (17.6%-70.8%, P< 0.0001) and intermediate risk patients (9.6%-28.0%, P < 0.0001).

screen.reason: Evaluates a real-world quality improvement deployment of a 90-day mortality prediction model coupled with automated notifications and targeted palliative consults to measure their impact on goals of care documentation.
